data.name: Bareek
data.gender_notes: Bareek is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'baraka' which means 'blessing'. In Islamic tradition, Bareek is a name given to a boy, symbolizing the hope that Allah (SWT) will bestow blessings upon him throughout his life. The name Bareek carries the meaning “Blessed” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Bareek usually hope their child will grow to embody blessed and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and power of Allah, providing protection and security
data.etymology: Bareek belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blessed.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bareek total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: باريك
in_arabic.meaning: باريك يعني ضعيف أو نحيف أو قليل العمق
in_arabic.long_meaning: باريك هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ب-ر-ك' والذي يعني الضآلة أو النحافة. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق وصفي للنباتات والأشجار ذات الأعمار القصيرة أو الضعيفة. يعتبر اسم باريك من الأسماء ذات المعاني العميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية، حيث يرتبط بالتواضع والبساطة.

in_urdu.name: باريك
in_urdu.meaning: باريك کا مطلب ہے کمزور یا پتلا یا گہرا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: باريك ایک عربی نام ہے جو 'ب-ر-ك' جڑ سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے کمزوری یا نحافت۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، جہاں یہ تواضع اور سادگی کی علامت کے طور پر دیکھا جاتا ہے۔ اس کا ذکر اسلامی تقالید میں ایک ایسے شخص کے اوصاف کے طور پر بھی کیا جاتا ہے جو دنیا میں کمزور یا بے سہم ہوتا ہے لیکن روحانی طور پر مضبوط ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बारिक
in_hindi.meaning: बारिक का अर्थ है कमजोर या पतला या गहरा अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: बारिक एक अरबी नाम है जो 'ब-र-क' मूल से निकला है, जिसका अर्थ होता है कमजोरी या पतलापन। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रयोग होता है, जहां यह नम्रता और सादगी के प्रतीक के रूप में देखा जाता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में इसका उल्लेख एक ऐसे व्यक्ति के गुणों के रूप में किया जाता है जो दुनिया में कमजोर या असुरक्षित होता है लेकिन आध्यात्मिक रूप से मजबूत है।

in_pashto.name: باريک
in_pashto.meaning: باريک دى معنی کمزور یا پتلی یا لږ ژور
in_pashto.long_meaning: باريک دى يو عربي نوم دى چې د 'ب-ر-ك' ريښې څخه اخستى شوى دى، چې د کمزورۍ يا پتلى په معنى دى. دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو په مېنځ کې کارول کىږي، چرته چې دا د تواضع او سادگى د نښانى په توګه ليدل کىږي. په اسلامي دود کې دى د يوه داسې شخص د ځانګړتياوو په توګه ياد شوى دى چې په دنيا کې کمزور يا بې سہمى دى خو روحانى ډول سره قوى دى.

in_english.name: Bareek
in_english.meaning: Means weak, thin, or having little depth
in_english.long_meaning: Bareek is an Arabic name derived from the root 'b-r-k', signifying weakness or thinness. It appears in the Quranic context describing plants or trees with short lifespan or weak nature. In Islamic tradition, Bareek symbolizes humility and simplicity. Historically, it has been used across Muslim cultures to denote a person who is worldly weak but spiritually strong, reflecting a balance of character traits.

historical_references.reference: The name Bareek is believed to have originated from the name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad SAW named Baraka ibn Nufayr al-Tamimi. He was a prominent Sahabi (companion) who participated in many battles and was known for his piety and generosity. The name Bareek is said to mean 'the one who brings blessings'.

Another theory suggests that the name Bareek is derived from the Arabic word 'barakah', which means 'blessing' or 'divine blessing'. The name is often used as a title for Allah, indicating His infinite mercy and blessings. In this context, Bareek is a term of reverence and devotion used to invoke Allah's blessings upon an individual or a situation.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Bareek' is of Arabic origin and is often used in Islamic culture as an invocation or blessing, seeking God's protection and blessings. In modern contexts, it has expanded beyond religious contexts and can be found in various secular areas. One popular usage is in the context of Middle Eastern cuisine, where 'Bareek' refers to a deep-fried pastry called 'sambusa' or 'samosa'. It is also used on Instagram, TikTok, and YouTube as a hashtag for content related to this dish. Another secular usage of 'Bareek' can be found in the realm of wellness and spirituality, where it is used as a term of endearment or as a sign of wishing peace and blessings on others. Overall, the name 'Bareek' has become a versatile term with a rich cultural heritage, transcending religious and secular boundaries and finding a place in various social media platforms.
